prompts.text: What kind of music do you usually hear coming from shops in your area?
Tell me about a song everyone around you seemed to know before you learnt its name.
A live musician at a neighbourhood gathering or somebody playing familiar songs from a small speaker?
The same tune sometimes follows you through several different places on a single day.
You're making a playlist for someone spending their first weekend in your town. Which mood would you start with?
What song makes people around you start singing even when nobody planned to?
Music heard in ordinary public places becomes part of how we remember them.
Describe a time a familiar local tune started a conversation with a stranger.
A visitor hears a song playing everywhere and asks why people love it. Whose story would you share?
What type of music seems to appear at almost every family gathering you attend?
What's a small everyday custom you noticed on a trip before you noticed any major attractions?
Tell me about buying something ordinary in another place and learning a new way to do it.
Learning how locals order breakfast or joining a familiar-looking game with different rules?
The smallest differences in daily routines sometimes stay with travellers longer than the sights.
You're spending one free afternoon in a new town with a local friend. What ordinary activity would you ask to join?
What have you seen people do in public elsewhere that would attract attention where you live?
A good local recommendation often starts with somewhere people go on a normal weekday.
Describe a moment when somebody patiently helped you understand a custom you hadn't encountered before.
A friend from abroad visits your area and finds a familiar routine surprising. How would you explain it?
What's a habit you brought home from a trip because you liked the way people did it there?
